physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the immune system, the body's long quiet conversation with itself about what belongs and what does not. It is the right seat. The shadow of this card was always a story about messages getting garbled in transit, copies of copies, fear smudging the ink at every cell it passed through. The immune system is where that story is told most literally. Every minute of every day, your cells are reading each other, asking, is this me, is this useful, is this safe. When the reading goes right, the body is at peace with itself. When it goes wrong, the body turns on its own quiet rooms and calls them intruders.

The shadow has its bodily floor in that misreading. The slow inflammations, the susceptibilities, the conditions that turn up after long stretches of resignation. The body believing the world is hostile because the mind has been telling it so. The climb out of the shadow shows up the same way, lower. Inflammations settle. The reactivity drops. The body stops bracing.

Equilibrium is not won here once. It is the immune system's daily work, constant small correction, the same constant small correction the card has been teaching all along, only deeper, where there is no decision to make about it. The body is already doing it. It is asking only that nothing else gets in the way.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Glutamic acid. Unlike the amino acid the very first card rests on, this one the body makes for itself. It does not need to be brought in. It is the most abundant amino acid in the human body, and in the brain it is the primary excitatory signal, the chemistry of one cell telling another to fire, to speak, to act.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the soft centre of this card. The code that hinges on the corruption of messages, on data lost in transcription, on the rot that creeps into anything passed through fear, runs at its deepest level on the very chemistry of messaging. The most carried signal in you is the signal this card answers to.

Which is why the card keeps coming back to the same instruction. Tune the messengers. Clean what passes through. The corruption was never in the message itself. It was in what the body was carrying when it passed the message along.
